about_the_game:
You have been sent on a mysterious quest and stumbled upon a great treasure. However, this treasure has quickly become a great burden with dangerous power that you don't know how to control. Getting rid of this isn't going to be easy, that's for sure.

Luckily, four individuals have stepped up to help you. Each companion has their own skills and strengths, and their fair share of secrets. Maybe you can find a way to their hearts... if you manage to survive this grand adventure before you.

About

You play as the main driving factor of the story. Choose your name and pronouns, and explore the world with one of four companions to rid yourself of the curse that you may have accidentally brought upon yourself. Everyone has secrets to reveal, and who knows. Maybe your dilemma isn't as dire as you once thought.

Features

  • Be Who You Want To Be: With the options to choose your identity, you can play who you want to play. The MC is never physically described, so you can imagine them to be however you want!

  • Your Choices Matter: Some of them might lead you down some unexpected paths. Be careful with your decisions, lest you lead yourself astray.

  • Unlock Exclusive Artwork: Progress the story to unlock special illustrations of the moments you spend with them. From stolen moments to vulnerable confessions, acquiring each will unlock their slot in the gallery.

short_description: Being given extraordinary power could be a blessing. Unfortunately for you, it has manifested into a curse. Seek the help from one of four companions to rid you of this heavy burden. Experience danger, magic, and romance as you attempt to free yourself from the dangerous power in your hands.
